outstanding: HLS-CRASH-01: One Firefox target crash during candidate core + Hls 1.5.17 grouped teardown; attribution unresolved. Passing repetitions do not resolve it. First trace path was overwritten by the subsequent suite; report/error stack retained. Later diagnostic traces copied to a dedicated cache directory.

HLS-PLAYBACK-01: Diagnostic repetitions encountered a separate SDK 1.7.2 + published core Firefox switch stall: audio group updated but video stayed 90P. Origin unverified; retained trace and SDK/browser state.
scope: Pinned 1.5.17 and 1.7.2 SDK builds, local generated media and real desktop workers. No SDK interval, Safari/native/device certification, external network coverage or isolated installation claim. Parent HLS-05 remains incomplete.
